protocol.selection: Greedy logdet at T=2.5 with mandatory roots 0,1,2,3; sorted input columns.
protocol.training: 55 Adam epochs, lr=0.035, gradient norm clipped to 5; final epoch used for all four trained policies.
protocol.linear_training: Initialized from CARE; one-hop mask or full-state gain; zero bias and tanh actuation.
protocol.neural_training: Identical initialization, architecture and static node features; self_only replaces the message matrix by I before training.
protocol.precision: CPU float32 fixed-step RK4 with zero-order-held controls / policy evaluation; metrics accumulated in float64
protocol.quadrature: J uses trapezoidal sums of state and sampled policy command squares, including the endpoint. applied_input_energy integrates the piecewise-constant applied commands.
protocol.settling_time: null when the state norm never settles below 15% of its initial value before the horizon.
